title: [clinic · EX-15] Make the dense leg earn its keep
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-15` — Make the dense leg earn its keep](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-15-make-the-dense-leg-earn-its-keep.md) · difficulty ⚫

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Raising the dense weight until aggregate recall improves, without checking which classes it damaged.

**2.** Comparing the dense leg alone against the hybrid, rather than against the hybrid *without* it — the marginal contribution is the question.

**3.** Concluding the dense leg is useless when the encoder is the problem. [ADR-0003](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/20-decisions/0003-lsa-default-encoder.md) says the default encoder is deliberately weak.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-15]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
